verdict.rationale: An API client platform could plausibly ship official SDKs for programmatic access, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no official Insomnia SDK. Code-snippet generation for users' own APIs, the Inso CLI, and the ability to build plugins are adjacent features or building blocks, not official SDKs for building against Insomnia.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
